ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure shows the process flow of "coal-to-oil"; after pulverized coal enters the process on the left, before entering the subsequent equipment, it is marked that water needs to be added, specifically written as "1 ton of coal plus 2.5 tons of water"; at the same time, catalyst and hydrogenation also need to be added; afterward, through steps such as reactor and separation and fractionation, gasoline and diesel are produced and carbon dioxide is discharged. Then reason: the question limits the implementation of the "coal-to-oil" project to the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region. The diagram highlights that this process uses a relatively large amount of water, while Inner Mongolia is located in China's northern inland area, where water resources are relatively scarce, so the main limiting factor is shortage of water resources.
